dex.entry: A large moon-moth whose wings have crystallised into translucent ice-panels etched with star-map engravings. It navigates by the stars with uncanny precision and can flash-freeze the air around it. Its wings are literally a star atlas carved in ice — the most visually stunning moth in Vesperholm.

art.silhouette: Wide-span moth, deep midnight-blue body, enormous translucent ice-panel wings with fine star-chart etchings glowing silver, trail of ice-crystal motes; grand and luminous at 64px.
